## Notes

Maxis 1991, Will Wright and Justin McCormick; based on Holldobler and Wilson's The Ants; yellow player ant, swap by double-click; trails to food and enemies; recruiting followers; worker, soldier, queen, and drone castes; hazards including rain, lawnmowers, spiders, antlions; Quick, Full, and Experimental games; SNES 1993.
